Name: Truly Invincible
Author: Kithplana
Description:
Mine in peace. Prevents you taking damage from anything. Monsters, bombs, mineshafts; you name it, it's harmless. Does not prevent debuffs.

I wrote this for myself so that I could access combat area content while maintaining my chill. With this mod, you can wander through the Mines, Skull Cavern, Volcano, and anywhere hazardous without taking any damage. You can still get debuffs from monsters, but (to my knowledge) none of those actually damage your health or are very troublesome.

This mod should work with other mods' monsters and most other causes of HP loss. It is written for 1.6 but might work for older versions too.

Technical details: This mod consists of two small, targeted Harmony patches. The main one overrides [i]StardewValley.Farmer.takeDamage[/i], and a special one for Skull Cavern mineshaft jumps saves the player's current HP value and restores it after the jump. This mod is open source under the MIT License.
